'''Malkite themfar''' was a lethal neurotoxin used extensively by [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and the [[Malkite Poisoners]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] used darts laced with this substance on his knee pad rocket dart launchers. It worked instantaneously, and could be applied to weapons in a variety of ways. A being could even apply it to their fingernails, let the poison dry, and it would still retain its potency.

Malkite themfar could cause [[Death/Legends|death]] inside ten [[Standard second|seconds]] once it was injected into a target's [[Blood/Legends|bloodstream]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
